challenges.code:
DOCS = [
    ("contracts", 400_000),
    ("codebase", 500_000),
    ("wiki", 300_000),
    ("logs", 90_000),
]

BUDGET = 1_000_000

def pack(docs, budget):
    used = 0
    for name, tokens in docs:
        if used + tokens <= budget:
            used += tokens
            print(f"packed {name} ({tokens})")
        else:
            print(f"skipped {name} ({tokens})")
    return used

used = pack(DOCS, BUDGET)
print(f"used={used} remaining={BUDGET - used}")
